newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish bonds end bit higher, backed by the peseta.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bonds end bit higher, backed by the peseta.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Bonos end higher on Monday after lacklustre trade with bonds drawing little support from a stronger peseta * 10-yr 8.8 pct T-bond 114.02 vs 113.76, yield 6.70 vs 6.72 * March future 113.68 vs 113.43 at yesterday's close * Peseta/mark 84.13/14 vs 84.17/20 mark (Background/details follow)
